activity: E127 closed: 1.143276% slower overall in three matched pairs. All scoped correctness checks passed; no new gain adopted. E080/GPU/compressed/Rayon16/default affinity remains qualified and live. Future-model handoff preserves the current RAM baseline, closed experiments and validation rules. No further experiment is running.

baseline.full_cycle_definition: Registered three-fixture compressed postflop complete cycles, RTX5090, warm driver cache. Includes tree/CPU allocation, all GPU initialization/NVRTC/JIT, same-quality solve/checks/full readback. Excludes Cargo, fingerprints, final destruction, API/browser latency and saving. Fresh16 incremental and fresh-original cumulative are separate observations; percentages never added. Actual CPU/memory/capacity/graph/compiled-resource and temporary-server HTTP bounds passed on tested workloads. No universal, cold-start, other-GPU, F32-speed, physical instantaneous peak, global CPU, browser rendering/input-latency or statistical-significance claim.

accepted_complete_run.method: Registered three-fixture compressed postflop complete cycles, RTX5090, warm driver cache. Includes tree/CPU allocation, all GPU initialization/NVRTC/JIT, same-quality solve/checks/full readback. Excludes Cargo, fingerprints, final destruction, API/browser latency and saving. Fresh16 incremental and fresh-original cumulative are separate observations; percentages never added. Actual CPU/memory/capacity/graph/compiled-resource and temporary-server HTTP bounds passed on tested workloads. No universal, cold-start, other-GPU, F32-speed, physical instantaneous peak, global CPU, browser rendering/input-latency or statistical-significance claim.

validation.summary: E080 passed the registered performance, exactness, capacity, CPU/memory, graph/resource, holdout and application checks. All 16 confirmation pairs improved. 86 solver tests and 20 server tests passed. The existing experimental symmetry test still fails identically in both versions and is not cleared.

deployment.summary: Exact qualified E080 server restored after the Windows reboot. Saved-file inventory and served UI bytes are unchanged. Research continues on port 43735.

correctness.details: Full non-timing states, settings, stopping iterations and convergence checkpoints match exactly. E080 also passed separate confirmation, F32, save/resume, large warm-state, capacity and full-range holdout checks. Performance is scoped to the registered workloads.

Registers rose from 62 to 68; the default 128-thread occupancy limit fell from eight to seven blocks per SM, and the function thread limit fell from 1,024 to 896. The fixed resource guards failed. No mapping or width variants were tested.

experiments.title: Independent raw-prefix consumers

experiments.reason: Rejected. All 86 ordinary tests, 1,820 direct GPU pairs, 18 full solve records and 138 convergence checkpoints passed. accepted_history.method: Three alternating baseline/candidate pairs; sum of per-fixture medians. Fresh compressed native solves, warm driver cache: tree construction, GPU initialization including runtime compilation, fixed-quality solving and full readback. Cargo build, fingerprinting, browser/API latency and disk saving excluded. Gain is in initialization; no claim of faster iterations or resumed/F32 solves.

Three alternating original-baseline/candidate pairs; sum of per-fixture medians. Fresh compressed native solves on RTX 5090 with a warm driver cache: tree construction, GPU initialization including runtime NVRTC/JIT, fixed-quality solving/checks and full readback. Cargo builds, fingerprinting, destruction after fingerprinting, browser/API latency and disk saving excluded. E004 improves initialization; E015 reduces repeated reach propagation during solving. F32 and saved/resumed correctness passed; their performance and cold-start performance are not qualified.

Registered three-fixture compressed postflop suite on RTX 5090; three alternating fresh-original/candidate pairs, sum of fixture medians. Tree construction, GPU initialization including runtime NVRTC/JIT, fixed-quality solve/checks and full readback are included. Cargo compilation, fingerprinting, final destruction, API/browser latency and disk saving are excluded. Warm-cache observations do not qualify cold-start behavior; no significance, universal tree/range/device or F32-speed claim. Cumulative gain includes retained E004/E015 plus E020; the separately measured E020 increment is not added to prior percentages.

Registered three-fixture compressed postflop complete cycles on RTX5090, warm driver cache. Includes tree/CPU allocation, GPU init/NVRTC/JIT, same-quality solve/checks and full readback. Excludes Cargo, fingerprints, final destruction, API/browser latency and saving. Separate fresh16-pair incremental confirmation and fresh3-pair original comparison; percentages are never added. Exact controls and allocation/resource evidence cover registered cases; no universal, cold-start, other-device or F32-speed claim.
